[[File:Aron Eisenberg DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Aron Eisenberg signing at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Aron Eisenberg''' was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]], billed as Nog from ''Star Trek: Deep Space Nine''.<ref name="guests">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Special guests], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122135443/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="lal-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 2 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120001100/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/friday.html Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher photographed him signing autographs, with Tournaments Coordinator [[Bruce Umene]] at the same table.<ref name="fri30">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri30.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri30], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Tournaments Coordinator Bruce Umene does the macarena while Aron Eisenberg signs." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000524052557/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri30.html Internet Archive]</ref> Star Trek CCG held its third World Championship at the convention, won by Mike Harrington, and Young Jedi held its World Championship, won by Greg Heisler.<ref name="sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html DecipherCon '99 — Day 3 Wrap-up], Francis K. Lalumiere, Decipher (1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== DecipherCon 1999 ==
On Friday, 12 November 1999, Eisenberg made his first appearance at the convention with Chase Masterson, [[Jeremy Bulloch]] and [[Shannon Baksa]], spending several hours with fans.<ref name="lal-fri" /> Convention guests crowded around Masterson and Eisenberg,<ref name="fri29">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri29.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri29], Decipher (1999). Caption: "DecipherCon guests crowd around Star Trek celebs Chase Masterson and Aron Eisenberg." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000524081555/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri29.html Internet Archive]</ref> and Tournament Director Barbie Buchanan, with her son Nathanael and daughter Amanda, led the parade of fans arriving to meet the four guests.<ref name="fri31">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri31.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri31], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Tournament Director Barbie Buchanan, son Nathanael and daughter Amanda lead the parade of fans who've arrived to meet Chase Masterson, Shannon Baksha, Jeremy Bulloch and Aron Eisenberg." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000601224918/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri31.html Internet Archive]</ref> Bruce Umene did the macarena while Eisenberg signed.<ref name="fri30" />

On Saturday, 13 November, the guests were back for another afternoon with their fans.<ref name="sat" /> [[Bill Martinson]] of Decipher Product Development checked in with Eisenberg,<ref name="sat52">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat52.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat52], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Decipher Product Development hombre Bill Martinson checks in with Aron Eisenberg of Star Trek: Deep Space Nine." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000524181114/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat52.html Internet Archive]</ref> and the two promoted a message of peace.<ref name="sat53">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat53.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat53], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Peace is the message that Bill Martinson of Decipher and Star Trek: Deep Space Nine's Aron Eisenberg are promoting." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000524144038/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat53.html Internet Archive]</ref> Eisenberg also hammed it up with DecipherCon staff.<ref name="sat69">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat69.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat69], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Aron Eisenberg hams it up with DecipherCon staff." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000529131804/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat69.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Over his signing sessions with Decipher fans, Eisenberg signed a thousand collectibles.<ref name="sat62">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat62.html DecipherCon 1999 Saturday photo sat62], Decipher (1999). Caption: "Known to his many fans as Nog on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, Aron Eisenberg signed a thousand collectibles during his sessions with Decipher fans." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000518140552/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/SAT/sat62.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Gen Con 2000 ==
At Gen Con 2000 in Milwaukee, Eisenberg appeared courtesy of Corsair Publishing. In exchange for a contribution to the National Kidney Foundation of Southern California, he signed 8×10 photographs and posed for photographs with fans. ''Star Trek Communicator'' pictured him with its columnist Jim Brumbaugh.<ref name="stc131">Jim Brumbaugh, "Gen Con, Gaming & Gifts", ''Star Trek Communicator'' 131 (2000), Decipher, pp. 68–69. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-131/page/n70/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref>
